units: <cite ref="Gittin 27b:9">Gitt. 27ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 19a:1">B. Mets. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אי סימנא … או ט׳ ע׳ וכ׳</he> if you require a special mark, I have one on it, if you require identification on general impression, I have it (I recognize it).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 23b:11">Ib. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>להדורי … מרבנן בט׳ ע׳</he> as to restoring it to a scholar on his identification &c., v. preced.—
<cite ref="Chullin 96a:3">Ḥull. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>אית לן ט׳ ע׳ בגויה</he> we know him by his general impression (not by special marks).
<cite ref="Chullin 96a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ט׳ ע׳ דקלא</he> identification by one’s voice; a. fr.
